action: Phoebe advises recipients to review the letter, use the complimentary credit monitoring Medcom offers, call the toll-free number in the letter (1-888-517-6590), and never give sensitive information in response to unsolicited calls, emails or texts.
date_note: Date of Phoebe's statement; the page gives only that the incident at Medcom occurred in 2025.

evidence.quote: a data security incident that occurred in 2025

exec: Phoebe says a former billing vendor, Medcom, had a 2025 data security incident and patients are receiving notification letters.
geo_basis: organisation HQ as stated by source
plain: Phoebe Putney Health System says some patients have received letters from Medcom, a former billing vendor, about a 2025 data security incident. Phoebe says the letters are legitimate.
summary: Phoebe Putney Health System says in a statement that some patients have recently received letters from Medcom, a third-party vendor that previously provided billing assistance services to Phoebe, about a data security incident that occurred in 2025. Phoebe says it no longer does business with Medcom and that the notifications are legitimate and not a scam. The statement gives no count of people and does not list the data types.
title: Phoebe confirms data breach notifications issued by former third-party vendor Medcom

validation.note: One page read: Phoebe's own statement as published by the Americus Times-Recorder (byline Phoebe). Medcom's letter and any regulator filing were not read.
